key_terms: A name a task uses to request endpoint, login, credential and extra settings at runtime, keeping deployment values out of DAG code.
A configured external store from which Airflow can resolve connections and variables instead of reading them from metadata storage.
An installable package that supplies integration-specific hooks and operators. A connection record cannot create a missing provider.
A bounded observation that records which connection fields were present and valid without printing credential values.
evidence: Project-only actual product commands with independent fixture oracles. Source preparation, native runtime observations and restart evidence are recorded separately in the workshop qualification ledger.
